# qbittorrent_webui_preferences (Resource)

Singleton partial ownership of server-stored WebUI Behavior settings. Import ID: application. Unset attributes remain unmanaged; removing an attribute or destroying the resource preserves stored settings. color_scheme=auto and display_density=default explicitly reset their overrides. Changes may require a browser reload. Use one instance per server.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "qbittorrent_webui_preferences" "behavior" {
  date_format                    = "default"
  color_scheme                   = "auto"
  display_density                = "default"
  use_alt_row_colors             = false
  dblclick_download              = "1"
  dblclick_complete              = "1"
  dblclick_filter                = "1"
  hide_zero_status_filters       = false
  add_new_torrent_dialog_enabled = true
  full_url_tracker_column        = false
  use_virtual_list               = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `add_new_torrent_dialog_enabled` (Boolean) Display torrent content and options when adding torrents.
- `color_scheme` (String) Color scheme: auto, light or dark. auto removes the stored override.
- `date_format` (String) Date format: default, MM/dd/yyyy, h:mm:ss AM/PM; MM/dd/yyyy, HH:mm:ss; dd/MM/yyyy, HH:mm:ss; yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss; yyyy/MM/dd HH:mm:ss; dd.MM.yyyy, HH:mm:ss; MMM dd, yyyy, h:mm:ss AM/PM; or dd MMM yyyy, HH:mm:ss.
- `dblclick_complete` (String) Completed torrent double-click: 0 no action, 1 start/stop.
- `dblclick_download` (String) Downloading torrent double-click: 0 no action, 1 start/stop.
- `dblclick_filter` (String) Filter double-click: 0 no action, 1 reset selection.
- `display_density` (String) Display density: default or compact. default removes the stored override.
- `full_url_tracker_column` (Boolean) Display full announce URL in the Tracker column.
- `hide_zero_status_filters` (Boolean) Automatically hide zero status filters.
- `use_alt_row_colors` (Boolean) Use alternating row colors.
- `use_virtual_list` (Boolean) Enable optimized table rendering.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Singleton ID: application.
